title: None of these mean you did anything wrong. They're signals that the feed has wound you up.

copy.instagram_caption:
None of these mean you did anything wrong. They're signals that the feed has wound you up.

The fix is small: one long, slow exhale, then a few more. About a minute is usually enough to feel the edge come off.

Which one do you notice first? Tell us below.

DeRot is coming soon to iPhone. Launch list: link in bio.

images.alt: Signs the scroll has gotten to you
You've read the same comment twice Your eyes are moving but nothing is going in. Attention is usually the first thing to go.
Your jaw is doing something Clenched, pushed forward, or just tight. Unclench it now and notice the difference.
Your breath has gone shallow Short breaths, high in the chest, without you noticing when it started.
You feel wired, not informed That buzz isn't a character flaw. It's a cue to come back down for a minute.
